mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may affect pioglitazone efficacy and increase hypoglycemic risk; pioglitazone may worsen fluid retention which is problematic in foscarnet-induced renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood glucose closely; consider alternative antiviral if possible; adjust pioglitazone dosing based on renal function and glycemic control.
